text_block_list.text:
One day, after our journey together
with <chrname> reached a milestone.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Hello,
Trainer <username>.
Thank you for working so hard this late.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
*ahem*
...Trainer <username>.
Do you have plans for tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
If not, I would appreciate a moment of your time.
There is something I wish to discuss.

—The next day, she brought me
to a high plateau overlooking the entire town.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...What a lovely sky.
The sunlight is so warm and refreshing.
choice_data_list: Um, why are you here today?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...If you wish to open your heart, an open space without walls would be best.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Sometimes, I wonder. What if I had never met you...?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: What if, in the end, I failed to change any of those rigid, stubborn views...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"Watching over immature girls and fostering their independence"?
That's just a pretty way of putting it.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
That's no different from outright neglect.
It's just an irresponsible adult making excuses.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I will manage the students thoroughly and carve out the correct path myself.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Everyone simply needs to walk the path again.
That way, there will be nothing left to fear.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
—That, and that alone,
is the only way to protect our Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Because of past events,
I was unilaterally forcing a path on her.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...While telling them to trust me,
I hadn't even truly faced them.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
As an educator……
and as a trainer, I have failed.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
No. The ones who made me realize that
were you... and our irreplaceable Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...You remind me of how I used to be.
Passionate, earnest, and full of faith in Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: That's all the more reason... why they couldn't bring themselves to acknowledge you.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...What is with that look of pure anticipation in your eyes?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Just kidding.
I suppose we'll have to acknowledge it.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It reminded me of so many things.
...Of you, who taught me so much.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...I was able to meet a wonderful rival.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Where could Trainer Kashimoto be?
I heard she was headed this way, but...

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, mind making way,
Little Cocon?!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
I shall be the first to locate Trainer Kashimoto!
Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wha... I was here first!
(Patter patter patter...!)

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Are those voices Little Cocon and Bitter Glasse?
Good grief, yelling in a public place like this...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It cannot be helped.
Our adult chat ends here.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we go, Trainer <username>?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: My lovely students are waiting for me, after all.
